name: GYEN
oneLiner: GYEN is GMO Trust's NYDFS-chartered JPY stablecoin now in wind-down, with purchases disabled and redemption-only access open during the initial period.
collateral: Japanese yen reserves held in FDIC-insured financial institutions, government money-market funds, or U.S. Treasury bills (≤3 months to maturity) per NYDFS guidelines
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption for JPY through GMO Trust (NYDFS-chartered trust company)

genius.notes: GYEN has NYDFS trust-company supervision and monthly attestations, but no public GENIUS state-qualified approval or official application source was located. GMO-Z.com Trust Company announced a wind-down of GYEN and ZUSD issuance on May 15, 2026, with the parent GMO Internet Group dissolving the subsidiary and recording a ¥2.2bn write-down; the entity is pursuing a strategic shift to Japan. No GENIUS authorization posture is expected to develop given the planned dissolution.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: NYDFS trust-company and reserve-attestation materials were found, but no token-specific public U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source was located for GYEN. GMO-Z.com Trust Company announced dissolution of its U.S. stablecoin operations on May 15, 2026, making future authorization pursuit unlikely.

notices.title: GYEN and ZUSD wind-down
notices.message: GMO-Z.com Trust Company announced an orderly wind-down of GYEN and ZUSD on May 15, 2026. Purchases are disabled; redemption remains available during the initial redemption period from May 15, 2026 through November 11, 2026 for eligible account holders.

notices.title: 2021 depeg and 2026 class-action settlement
notices.message: GYEN suffered multiple de-pegging events shortly after its 2021 launch (notably hitting >1.5x its peg in May 2021), causing material holder losses on Coinbase. A class action filed in 2022 (Donovan v. Coinbase / GMO Trust) led to a $6.75M proposed settlement; motion for final approval was filed on April 17, 2026 with a final-approval hearing set for May 27, 2026. Settlement class covers GYEN purchasers in New York or California between Dec 29, 2020 and Oct 10, 2025. Methodology-relevant historical record of peg failure for an otherwise NYDFS-supervised issuer.

mintAuthority.summary: GYEN uses GMO Trust's role-based fiat-token contract: a minter mints within capacity, while owner/admin roles can change privileged accounts and parameters.

controls.label: GYEN current minter
controls.capDescription: GMO Trust source describes a capacity limit: minter cannot mint beyond capacity, while a separate capper can adjust capacity.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: GYEN is issued by GMO-Z.com Trust and tracked across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana, and Stellar-style issuer rails. No third-party bridge route was verified; the reviewed posture is issuer-native mint/redeem across supported networks.
